statements.label: lem:curve
statements.restatement: Bounded-curve principle: on an irreducible affine curve with sum Re f_j = 1 and L bounded, L>=0 on the boundary strata implies L>=0 where all g_j>0.

statements.label: lem:safe
statements.restatement: If x + C kappa lies in X then Re Phi_O(x) >= min_sigma Re(Px)_sigma for all O in O(4).

statements.label: thm:six
statements.restatement: For fixed O: the support inequality for all x in X with >=6 contacts implies it for all x in X (paper Thm 3.6).

statements.label: prop:inventory
